preview: An interview experience for the Graduate Technical Analyst role at Deutsche Bank, detailing a 5-round process including an online coding test, multiple technical rounds, a professional fitness round, and an HR round.
content: Deutsche Bank visited our campus in August 2024 to hire final year students for the role of Graduate Technical Analyst in Technology Data and Innovation (TDI) Business Division. Eligibility Criteria: CPI: 7 and above. Branches: Computers, IT & EXTC (Electronics and Telecommunication). Total number of rounds conducted: 5. 1. Online Coding Test. 2. Technical Round-1. 3. Technical Round-2. 4. Professional-fitment Round. 5. HR Round. Round 1 (27th July, 2022) (1.5 hrs) It was an online test on Hacker Earth platform. There were 3 coding questions in this round. The questions were of easy-medium difficulty. The scores for questions were 20,50,50 respectively. There were marks for partial test cases. 1st coding question Power Limit You are given power A and B. At each second, you have to select one resource out of 2 to run the software. Every second, the power of the selected resource gets reduced by 2 and the power of unselected resource gets charged by 1. The software stops when at least one resource's power reaches 0. The task was to find the maximum runtime of the software with the given resources A and B. Kiran Patil computer Engineering 2021-2024 Sample output PageB PageD PageA PageC 2nd coding question Auto suggest Given a dictionary consisting of N words and a query word S. You need to auto-suggest the best word from the dictionary that is closest to S. Two words are first compared by their Levenshtein distance to the word S. If two words have the same Levenshtein distance, then the lexicographically smaller word is given priority. (Levenshtein distance between two strings is defined as the minimum number of edits required to obtain one string from the other. An "edit" is defined by either an insertion of a character, a deletion of a character, or a replacement of a character.) 3rd coding question: Backlink sorting You are given N web page titles and corresponding arrays that contain the number of backlinks for each web page. The objective is to rank the web pages in descending order based on the number of backlinks they have. If two or more web pages have the same number of backlinks, maintain their original order. I was able to solve all three questions before time. 40 Students were shortlisted from the online test for the next round. There was a Online Pre-Placement Talk on 8th August for the shortlisted on Teams from 3 to 3:30. Sample input 4 PageA PageB PageC PageD 10 15 10 12 All the interviews were held offline. So we were supposed to reach TPO seminar hall at 8:30 am in formals with 4 copies of resume. Round 2 Technical Interview 9th August 2023: 1. Introduce yourself. 2. Tell me about the projects that you have done so far. 3. What all subject you have covered so far since your diploma and what’s the difference that you have observed between diploma and B.Tech. 4. Which was your favorite subject so far? 5. Then interviewer started grilling on the main interview. She asked me to Write a program to swap 2 numbers in ‘C’ without using temp variable.(interviewer deliberately told me to do in c I said I had C in my first year of diploma its been so long now still I’ll try I written the program and told 2 approaches using arithmetic operators and bitwise XOR and written program for both). 6. What are the joins in SQL. 7. Write a sql query find unique records in table to delete the duplicate rows from the table. First I wrote a query with distinct keyword and created a new table with subquery then she told can you do it without using distinct so wrote the query similar to following subquery. She replied good and asked me is there any other alternate way? she also gave me a hint over there can we use join here I got the idea and said we can use Inner join to remove duplicates. 8. Could you please provide an overview of some popular cloud platforms. 9. What is GCP (Google cloud platform) have you used any cloud platform so far. 10. Do you know scaling in cloud platforms. I explained the scaling including its types as horizontal scaling and vertical scaling. Follow up question what are benefits of it which is more feasible. 11. What are the benefits of virtualization. I asked in what context in OS or cloud platform so they told me to tell both. 12. Have you worked on Linux – ( I replied yes) write a command for list the files in current dir and show only text files. 13. Then she told me to write a program for extracting the text files in current directory choose any lang you comfortable (I choose python). 14. How much do you scale yourself in java out of 10. 15. Do you know subnetting what is it and what are benefits of it? 16. Tell me about a situation where you faced difficulties and how did you tackle them. 17. As you have worked on several projects and have a internship experience did you faced any confits in team and how did you managed. 18. While working in team if have a better approach but your team is working with another approach how will you convince them to go with your approach? 19. She asked me a puzzle also. You have 15 Rs with you. You go to a shop and shopkeeper tells you price as 1 Rs per chocolate. He also tells you that you can get a chocolate in return of 3 wrappers. How many maximum chocolates you can eat? 20. Do you have any question for me? Round 3 Technical Interview 9th August 2023: 1. Introduce yourself. 2. In introduction I mention my all rank so he grilled over there and then asked me where did you get this rank – I replied with DTE portal then asked me to open the mobile and go there Then I opened the link It was showing current merit list so he asked me where can I find previous ranking so I replied the is a DSE app on play store he told me to install the same. 3. Then he asked me to can you convert this application to a webapp where I can get this rank so told me to give a High level design of the MHTCET ranking portal with search functionality for all the years not only current. I asked sir how do you want the system and do need to display He replied design the system where I can have the search functionality where I could just enter the name and I should get his rank and all details. I understood the requirement and rote on paper whatever he needs. created a high-level design and explained. Then I moved on the tech stack we can use the elastic search functionality and about the deployment. 4. Then he asked consider you have the entire data at your local machine and you can use html css and js then write a code to implement the above. 5. While writing he asked how was internship experience? I answered while writing. 6. Then he asked me the tech stack and projects that I had worked on during my internship. 7. In one of the projects during internship I had created an application which was having a functionality to upload a pdf and send it to our AI module and get result he asked me to write a coed for it. 8. Then he grilled me on saying that I got to know from your TPO that you got and PPO form your interning company then why do you want to join DB. 9. Then he given me an situation where you are a team leader/senior position and you have 2 members in your team one is a tech guy who does all the work very quickly and second one is normal which does the job but the problem with first he/she is very arrogant so to whom you will fire if you do not fire anyone you will get fired. 10. Then he asked some basic DSA questions I answered all of them then he told me to write code for implementing Stack using queue in 2 mins and he was doing the countdown. They were checking my approach and coding slandered while writing the code in even in short time. I successfully written the code and took a deep breath and explained the code it was easy just the time factor was there. 11. Then he asked me Oops concepts. 12. What is polymorphism asked to write code to implement it. 13. What is inheritance what types of inheritance are possible in java. 14. How to access the properties of other class java? 15. What is pass by reference in java? 16. Different types of access specifiers in java? Round 4 Professional Fitness Round 9th August 2023: 1. Tell me about yourself. 2. Tell me about your projects. 3. Have you deployed these projects - I replies yes so he asked to show me the deployment if you can show I was having my mobile so I showed him. 4. How AI can be used in enhancing the banking sector what are the use cases. 5. How chatgpt works what exactly behind it and do you aware of any alternatives for it. 6. Is there any one in the IT field from your family – I replied no. 7. Where you from tell me something about your family background. 8. Internship experience at Mondelēz international and what projects you have worked on? 9. Do you have any plans for MS? 10. Do you have any questions for me? Round 5 HR Round: 1. Introduce yourself apart from the that you have mentioned in resume. 2. How was your day till now? Are you tired? 3. What was your best part of today. 4. Tell me about the project that you have worked on. 5. He was interested in smart attendance management project asked some follow up questions on the same. 6. My project was based on face recognition so he asked me after training the model in between if my face characteristics changed such as glasses or beard the will it be able to recognize my face and if no how you can tackle it. 7. So he asked are there any alternatives that we can use I replied we can use biometrics - finger prints. 8. Then he asked me can we use eye retina and how it can be used and its feasibility. 9. Do have any plans of further study. 10. At last he asked do you have any questions for me? All The interviews concluded around 7.30 PM and we got the results within an hour. Total 26 candidates got selected I was one of them. RESOURCES: Leetcode, Interview bit, Geeks for geeks. TIPS: 1. Keep some hard copies of your resume handy. 2. Be very thorough with your CS fundamentals. 3. Make sure to go through all projects on your resume and be prepared for questions that can be asked about them. 4. Keep calm and be confident. 5. Practice with Mock Interviews to gain some confidence. 6. Research about the company go through its website and social handles. 7. Prepare for behavioral questions. 8. Stay hydrated and eat food properly on interview day as the entire process is hectic.
